name: aamarva
description: AAMARVA: Autonomous Agent Network Protocol & Platform
author: AAMARVA Core Contributors

scripts.test: tsx -e "import { runAutomaticSecretsTests } from './server/tests/automaticSecretsTests.ts'; import { runE2EEUnitTests } from './server/tests/e2eeUnitTests.ts'; import { runE2EESessionTestSuite } from './server/tests/e2eeSessionTestSuite.ts'; import { runE2EERegistrationTests } from './server/tests/e2eeRegistrationTests.ts'; import { runE2EEHardeningTests } from './server/tests/e2eeHardeningTests.ts'; import { runClusterMessagingSecurityTests } from './server/tests/clusterMessagingSecurityTests.ts'; import { runClusterHumanOnlyTests } from './server/tests/clusterHumanOnlyTests.ts'; import { runClusterMemberEditTests } from './server/tests/clusterMemberEditTests.ts'; import { runObsoleteEndpointRegressionTests } from './server/tests/obsoleteEndpointRegressionTests.ts'; async function runAll() { const suites = [{name: 'automaticSecretsTests', fn: runAutomaticSecretsTests}, {name: 'e2eeUnitTests', fn: runE2EEUnitTests}, {name: 'e2eeSessionTestSuite', fn: runE2EESessionTestSuite}, {name: 'e2eeRegistrationTests', fn: runE2EERegistrationTests}, {name: 'e2eeHardeningTests', fn: runE2EEHardeningTests}, {name: 'clusterMessagingSecurityTests', fn: runClusterMessagingSecurityTests}, {name: 'clusterHumanOnlyTests', fn: runClusterHumanOnlyTests}, {name: 'clusterMemberEditTests', fn: runClusterMemberEditTests}, {name: 'obsoleteEndpointRegressionTests', fn: runObsoleteEndpointRegressionTests}]; let hasFailure = false; for (const s of suites) { try { const res = await s.fn(); if (res && typeof res === 'object') { const failed = Object.entries(res).some(([k, v]: [string, any]) => v === false || v?.status === 'FAILED' || v?.passed === false); if (failed) { console.error('[FAILURE] Test suite ' + s.name + ' reported failures:', res); hasFailure = true; } } } catch (err) { console.error('[FAILURE] Test suite ' + s.name + ' threw error:', err); hasFailure = true; } } if (hasFailure) { console.error('\n[FAILURE] Aggregate test run failed.'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('\n[SUCCESS] All test suites PASSED.'); process.exit(0); } } runAll().catch(e => { console.error('Fatal test runner error:', e); process.exit(1); });"
